players.product: neutral-atom quantum processors (200-qubit QPU hosted at Aramco's Dhahran data center)

quarterly_data.signal: French defense program (DGA): Pasqal 6-K - Pasqal is ending its participation in the French defense program LSQUARE (also known as PROQCIMA) of the Direction generale de l'armement (DGA), having participated in its first phase and completed all of that phase's technological objectives, as its collaboration with French public authorities shifts to commercial applications; it has been invited to civil public support programs being defined and was asked by the Secretariat general pour l'investissement (SGPI) and the Direction generale des entreprises (DGE) to submit a research and development program for neutral-atom fault-tolerant quantum computing.
